label: contract
text: Read requirements.txt completely using the read tool. Summarize the contract for parse_env in a few bullets. Do not implement yet.
answer:
- Return a new dictionary, copying `defaults` when supplied; require defaults to be a dictionary.
- Parse physical lines independently; ignore blank lines and full-line comments. Allow optional `export ` before a definition.
- Validate keys against `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`; allow whitespace before `=`.
- Trim unquoted values; recognize inline comments only when `#` starts the value or follows whitespace.
- Single quotes preserve contents; double quotes decode only the specified escapes. After a quote, allow only whitespace and an optional comment.
- Empty values and duplicate keys are allowed (last definition wins); malformed lines, keys, escapes, or quoting raise `ValueError`.
